rationale: The advisory (titled 'Treasury Targets Global Scam Networks and the Corporate Infrastructure That Enables Them', p.1) designates over two dozen Cambodian, Hong Kong, Singaporean, Malaysian, Mauritian and BVI entities spanning unrelated sectors (gambling, real estate, construction, insurance, aviation, aquaculture) that are each 'Linked To' one of a small handful of individuals (QIU, Yong; CHEN, Bo; PANG, Visal; DAI, An) tied to the Prince Group TCO. Several entities under QIU, Yong share the identical registered address 'Room D17, 5/F. Mai Gar Industrial Building, 146 Wai Yip Street, Kwun Tong, Kowloon, Hong Kong, China' (pp.3-5) and others share BVI registered-agent addresses at Wickhams Cay II, Road Town, Tortola (pp.3-6) -- the shared beneficial owner, shared address cluster, offshore registration and layered ownership structure PAT007 defines.

rationale: SAN002 is the TWIN of PAT008; this advisory is an OFAC sanctions-designation document (Cuba/Venezuela EO programs), so the sanctions twin SAN002 applies. Pages 6-7 show three tankers -- CARLOTA C (Panama flag) renamed MARIA CRISTINA (Cuba flag, same IMO 9502453); GIRALT (Panama flag) renamed LOURDES (Cuba flag, same IMO 9259692); and ESPERANZA f.k.a. NEDAS (Greece flag to Cuba flag, same IMO 9289166) -- all linked to the same operator, CAROIL TRANSPORT MARINE LTD, and all carrying both the VENEZUELA-EO13850 and newly added CUBA-EO14404 sanctions tags. This is SAN002's 'frequent vessel renaming' and 'repeated flag changes' under a 'common beneficial owner' operating under sanctioned programs.
